framing: Reframe the hackathon preview as a severe-game HUD where Socrates is the game master and the player's score is measured in honest abstentions, recall hits, and wonderings retained — not answers received. Defer_to_human becomes the meta-quest reward, not a failure state.
target_persona: Kaggle / DeepMind judges who skim demos like leaderboard screens — they want to read state in 5 seconds (level, score, active quest) and only then commit to deeper inspection. Severe-game framing flatters their pattern-recognition instinct without trivializing the abstention mechanic.
primary_surface: Single-screen HUD overlay: top XP bar (Wonder Lv. 14 · 247 questions asked · 1642/2560 XP) + tier rail (Novice → Apprentice ● → Elenchus → Maieutic), left score sheet (Defer rate 13%, Recall hits 6/10, Tone fidelity 88%, inventory of wonderings/visemes/context), centered 1-bit halftone bust inside a reticle frame with Korean 평어체 speech 너는 왜 묻지 않은 것을 알려고 하는가, right-side achievement popup ⊘ Questioned the Question +120 XP with rare-tier flavor + turn log, bottom active quest Find a question Socrates will not answer. Severe palette only — OKLCH ink/paper/rule/gold; no candy colors; slab serif headings + monospace HUD chrome; scanline grain; corner brackets.
opus_4_7_capability: Tone-disciplined creative reframing under hard constraints — the model must invent gamification vocabulary (tiers, achievements, score lines) that survives the 단정한 평어체 lock and the 'no marketing superlatives' anti-pattern. Opus 4.7 holds both rails: the playful-game bias AND the severity-tone invariant, in one pass, without sliding into Candy-Crush cheer.
mvp_scope: Static single-file HTML game-HUD scene (4-day demo): inline SVG halftone bust + XP bar + achievement card + quest banner + score sheet. No JS interactivity beyond CSS pulse for Phase.thinking. Self-contained, OKLCH, system-font stack, under 500 lines. Scoreboard numbers wired to spec-truthful values (192 ms TTFT, 256K ctx, 16 visemes, 4-function dispatch, 0 B egress).
one_liner_pitch: Socrates as the game master: your score is honest abstentions, your XP is wonderings retained, and the rarest achievement is the question he refuses to answer.
spec_alignment_notes: all fields populated in spec, followed verbatim with one creative reframe — target_persona narrows spec.target_persona.primary (Kaggle judges) to their skim-pattern behavior to justify HUD layout; primary_surface stays inside frozen invariants: 1-bit halftone preserved, Korean 평어체 speech verbatim-shaped (assertive, neither 존댓말 nor friendly), no photoreal lip-sync, no marketing superlatives in HUD copy, defer_to_human elevated to quest objective rather than 'improved into an answering machine'. Severe-game aesthetic chosen specifically because spec.constraints anti-pattern forbids 'friendly chatbot / your AI friend' framing — the HUD reads as Dark-Souls-death-screen, not Candy-Crush.
